name: cantools-pdk-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is cantools, a Python package of CAN bus tools: it parses and writes DBC, KCD,
SYM, ARXML and CDD database files, encodes and decodes CAN messages and diagnostic DIDs, and provides a
node tester, a candump log reader, J1939 and AUTOSAR helpers, a C source code generator and the `cantools`
command line (decode, dump, list, convert, generate_c_source, plot and monitor).

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the cantools package under src/cantools/: its database loading, dumping, encoding and decoding for the DBC, KCD, SYM, ARXML and CDD formats, its diagnostics, tester, log reader, J1939 and AUTOSAR helpers, its C source generator and its command-line subcommands, together with README.rst, docs/index.rst and the module, class and function docstrings of the package.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples; in-package code comments are only supporting
evidence, and when a comment conflicts with the documentation, follow the documentation.

The environment runs Python 3.11 with cantools' dependencies installed (including matplotlib and
diskcache) and has no network access; the package is imported from
